ruleDefinitions.name: Potential EACore.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "EACore.dll" Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\EACore\\\.dll$") AND  NOT (((process_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Electronic\\ Arts\\\\EA\\ Desktop\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX(".*\\\\EACoreServer\\\.exe.*")) AND ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Electronic\\ Arts\\\\EA\\ Desktop\\\\")))
